epics: Agree the operating model, source of truth, lifecycle and measurable pilot scope.
Prove tenant isolation, restrict privileged operations and protect driver evidence.
Bind a vehicle, driver and contract atomically and activate only with all required approvals.
Deliver resumable verified onboarding and accurate mobile states.
Produce replayable, server-validated campaign activity and trustworthy zone metrics.
Fund campaigns, manage invoice expiry and prevent unfunded delivery.
Reconcile every unit of money to campaign, vehicle, driver and beneficiary.
Implement the agreed simple fleet workspace with trustworthy data.
Make releases repeatable, incidents recoverable and the pilot auditable.

issues.summary: Establish canonical repositories and environment inventory
issues.description: Confirm authoritative deployed commits across mr2726/new_wrap_go, new_wrapgo_app and wrapgo_app; web/mobile source repositories are now located.
acceptance: Record repo, branch, commit, owner and runtime for each surface
Map environments and database projects without copying credentials
Match installed app and deployed web builds to commits
issues.evidence: GitHub repository discovery: mr2726/wrapgo_app and mr2726/new_wrapgo_app

issues.summary: Resolve payout beneficiary and schedule
issues.description: Weekly payout requirement conflicts with withdrawal mockup; mobile Payment says earnings are managed by fleet owner.
acceptance: Approve who receives funds and who owes driver compensation
Define weekly day, cutoff, fees, failures and holidays
Choose scheduled payouts or explicit withdrawal request model and align all surfaces

issues.summary: Approve pilot scope and success criteria
issues.description: Avoid implementing all platform surfaces without a measurable end-to-end pilot.
acceptance: Set advertiser/fleet/vehicle caps and campaign duration
Define activation, tracking completeness, reconciliation and support success measures
Name business owner and explicit exclusions

issues.summary: Publish domain model and state-transition matrix
issues.description: Status labels, invitation codes and stable entity IDs must have separate meanings.
acceptance: Define IDs and relationships for tenant, vehicle, driver, campaign, reservation, assignment and contract
Define transition actor, preconditions, timestamps, failure and compensation
Specify versioned API commands and concurrency rules

issues.summary: Configure Jira delivery governance
issues.description: Track outcomes and evidence instead of treating UI completion as feature completion.
acceptance: Map draft IDs to real issues after duplicate search
Set components, versions, workflow, owners and dependency links
Publish weekly risk, dependency, throughput and gate dashboard

issues.summary: Audit live RLS, grants and storage policies
issues.description: Location SQL does not declare RLS; live security cannot be inferred from the repository.
acceptance: Export deployed policies, grants, functions and bucket settings
Test anonymous, driver A/B, fleet A/B, advertiser and admin access
Deny cross-tenant reads/writes and client changes to financial or approval fields
issues.evidence: supabase/sql/20260717_driver_location_updates.sql; service.js direct writes; live policies unknown

issues.summary: Replace public document URL design with private evidence access
issues.description: Upload helper returns getPublicUrl for documents; actual public exposure depends on bucket configuration.
acceptance: Use private buckets and short-lived authorized access
Separate profile avatar from verification and registration evidence
Negative-test another user and expired links; restrict upload type and size

issues.summary: Protect fleet assets during driver account deletion
issues.description: Authenticated deletion deletes vehicles where signeddriveremail matches user; this can remove fleet-owned assets.
acceptance: Deletion detaches driver and preserves fleet vehicle/contract and required financial history
Derive allowed storage bucket/prefix on server, ignoring caller overrides
Use resumable deletion job with pagination, failure audit and retention policy

issues.summary: Move Telegram delivery and credentials to backend
issues.description: Mobile service accepts botToken and posts directly to Telegram; service lookup selects all columns.
acceptance: Client never receives bot credential
Server authorizes booking and queues notification
If live tokens were delivered to clients, rotate them and verify logs redact secrets
issues.evidence: service.js getServiceLocation and sendServiceVisitTelegramMessage; live token presence unverified

issues.summary: Harden sessions, privileged access and local data
issues.description: User data and auth persistence use AsyncStorage; choose storage controls based on threat model.
acceptance: Require MFA for privileged roles and step-up for payout method changes
Validate revocation, logout, account switching and local data cleanup
Document secure session storage and recovery strategy

issues.summary: Implement atomic invitation redemption and assignment
issues.description: Fleet code update writes driver then vehicle in separate requests and uses code as carid.
acceptance: Single server transaction validates authenticated driver, fleet, vehicle and contract eligibility
One-time expiring code is rate limited and safely stored; replay and simultaneous claims fail
Use stable vehicle ID; failed claim leaves no partial binding

issues.summary: Reserve contract capacity without overselling
issues.description: Loadboard booking needs atomic capacity control, eligibility checks and expiry.
acceptance: Concurrent requests for last slot yield one reservation
Expired or cancelled hold releases capacity once
Vehicle and funding eligibility checked server-side at booking and activation
issues.evidence: Contract loadboard mockup; backend not inspected

issues.summary: Record driver approval and guarded activation
issues.description: Photo submission and signed timestamps must not substitute for explicit contract acceptance.
acceptance: Record actor, versioned terms, consent time and contract snapshot
Activation requires driver approval, accepted verification, installation evidence and funded campaign
Fleet owner cannot approve on behalf of driver; invalid transitions fail
issues.evidence: service.js updateVehicleWrapPhotos writes signed_at on photo submission

issues.summary: Make photo review submission atomic and non-destructive
issues.description: Photo update, contract status and driver counters are separate writes; resubmission resets performance totals.
acceptance: Submitting evidence never resets lifetime or historical totals
Store evidence versions and explicit review state in one authorized command
Retry is idempotent; partial failures preserve previous valid state
issues.evidence: service.js updateVehicleWrapPhotos resets totaldistance, zonehourse and weeklyStat

issues.summary: Deliver wrap installation and recheck workflow
issues.description: Physical installation is part of delivery, not just a calendar entry.
acceptance: Persist provider, appointment, timezone, cancellation and completion evidence
Define rejection, correction, periodic photo check and wrap removal flows
Only authorized reviewer can approve; every decision has reason and history

issues.summary: Support controlled vehicle and driver reassignment
issues.description: Replacing a driver must not transfer old earnings or keep old access.
acceptance: End-date old assignment and create new one
Preserve historical driver/vehicle/contract attribution
Revoke old access and require new approval before activation

issues.summary: Fix Contracts missing-cache branch
issues.description: loadDriverContracts calls setUserData(null) although that setter is not defined.
acceptance: Missing userData produces valid empty or sign-in state
No ReferenceError or misleading backend failure
Test absent and malformed cache

issues.summary: Propagate password-reset failures
issues.description: changePassword logs provider error and resolves; screen then displays success.
acceptance: Rejected update throws or returns explicit failure
Screen stays on reset form and shows recoverable error
Success only after confirmed provider result

issues.summary: Use actual contract dates and resume evidence state
issues.description: Use WEB-47 booking+7-day and approved early-wrap rules consistently in mobile and web; mobile currently derives end from campaign created_at.
acceptance: Use approved campaign/assignment start and end fields
Restore both photo sides and review status after restart
Validate month-end dates and prevent repeated acceptance timestamps

issues.summary: Make verification resumable with actionable review feedback
issues.description: Complete identity, vehicle and photo checks while keeping server state authoritative.
acceptance: Draft persists across restart and interrupted upload
Rejected evidence has reason and resubmit flow
Verification status stays distinct from assignment and contract status

issues.summary: Reproduce and fix documented iOS navigation and layout issues
issues.description: Existing BUGS.md lists five issues but does not show resolution evidence.
acceptance: Reproduce splash/safe area, top control, keyboard dismissal, back navigation and birthdate layout
Create separate child bugs only for reproduced issues
Verify supported small and large iOS devices

issues.summary: Store immutable telemetry and compute authoritative aggregates
issues.description: Current client overwrites latest point and writes totals; paid activity needs replayable evidence.
acceptance: Authenticated immutable event IDs deduplicate retries
Server derives driver identity and assignment validity
Append-only raw events and versioned aggregation support replay; clients cannot write authoritative totals
issues.evidence: service.js uploadDriverLocationUpdates; location SQL unique driver_email

issues.summary: Prevent lost queued locations and replay inconsistencies
issues.description: Flush rewrites a snapshot of pending points; concurrent enqueue can be overwritten. Location and totals writes are separate.
acceptance: Enqueue during flush never loses new points
Server acknowledgment removes only acknowledged event IDs
Test crash after event write, aggregate failure, duplicate delivery and account switch

issues.summary: Calculate zone hours using campaign boundaries
issues.description: Existing calculation counts qualifying moving time; no polygon input is used before incrementing zonehourse.
acceptance: Approved versioned campaign polygon and schedule determine eligible zone time
Outside-zone movement never increases zone hours
Test boundary crossings, gaps, parked vehicle and invalid location
issues.evidence: location/weeklyStats.js; service.js nextZoneHours; isolated Node probe

issues.summary: Fix week rollover and timestamp attribution
issues.description: Rollover shifts history then overwrites index 0; whole batch uses latest timestamp week.
acceptance: Closed week remains in history and cannot be replaced by current week
Split segments and late events across approved business timezone periods
Test Sunday/Monday, multi-week offline batch and out-of-order events
issues.evidence: location/weeklyStats.js buildWeeklyStatsUpdate; Node probe lost previous 10 km / 1 h

issues.summary: Validate telemetry quality before earnings
issues.description: Mocked flag is captured but inspected stats do not reject it; no upper plausible speed check is present there.
acceptance: Reject or quarantine impossible travel, poor accuracy and suspicious samples
Define explainable thresholds and manual appeal
Compare measured routes to reference journeys and record rule version

issues.summary: Validate tracking on physical iOS and Android devices
issues.description: Background tracking code does not prove behavior under OS power restrictions.
acceptance: Test permission denial/revocation, background, screen-off, restart and low power
Measure route completeness, upload lag and battery impact against approved targets
Stop or clearly disclose tracking outside eligible sessions

issues.summary: Implement advertiser campaign lifecycle and funding rules
issues.description: Campaign creation, approval, pause, cancellation and funding must match contract delivery.
acceptance: Define targeting, monthly budget, slots, creative and dates
Only approved funded campaigns can activate assignments
Budget reservation, pause and termination have explicit effects on contracts

issues.summary: Resolve 2-day invoice expiry against bank transfer latency
issues.description: 24–48 hour transfers can arrive at invoice expiry; balance top-up and campaign invoices are different records.
acceptance: Define exact deadline/timezone and pending-bank-transfer treatment
Approve late/partial/overpayment and refund or balance-credit behavior
Concurrent bank confirmation and expiry cannot both finalize campaign
issues.evidence: Prior confirmed advertiser funding and 2-day expiry requirements

issues.summary: Integrate verified funding and bank reconciliation
issues.description: IDBank partnership is a direction; production API and settlement contract are unverified.
acceptance: Obtain bank integration specification and sandbox credentials through secure channel
Authenticate and deduplicate callbacks; reconcile settlement to ledger
Exercise declined, timed-out, delayed, reversed and duplicate payment cases

issues.summary: Expose defensible advertiser performance reporting
issues.description: Distance, zone time and estimated impressions must be clearly differentiated.
acceptance: Show data freshness, eligible vehicles and measurement period
Label estimates and document methodology without claiming verified impressions
Export consistent totals with contract and campaign attribution

issues.summary: Implement balanced immutable money ledger
issues.description: UI balances cannot be the financial source of truth.
acceptance: Use integer minor units, currency and balanced entries
Separate available, reserved, earned, payable and paid states
Every posting is idempotent; corrections use linked reversals and reconciled balances

issues.summary: Approve earnings formula and exceptions
issues.description: Monthly contract estimate needs an explicit weekly earning calculation.
acceptance: Define required distance and zone hours, partial periods, caps and missed checks
Version formula and store calculation inputs
Approve worked examples for partial activation, pause, replacement and disputed telemetry

issues.summary: Close performance periods and accrue earnings
issues.description: Convert validated activity to payable earnings reproducibly.
acceptance: Freeze or version period inputs and calculation
Allocate line items to campaign, contract, vehicle, driver and beneficiary
Late corrections produce audited adjustments and cannot silently rewrite paid periods

issues.summary: Execute weekly payouts with safe retry and reconciliation
issues.description: Grouped payment can cover several drivers; uncertain bank result must not cause double payment.
acceptance: Batch has beneficiary and covered line-item breakdown
Unknown result triggers bank lookup/reconciliation before retry
Partial failures retry only failed transfers; ledger agrees with bank confirmation

issues.summary: Produce invoice and payout detail with driver mapping
issues.description: Billing history must explain precisely what each payment covers.
acceptance: Detail shows period, contract, vehicle, driver, gross, deductions and net
Access is scoped to entitled tenant and beneficiary
Downloads reconcile to ledger and use approved invoice terminology

issues.summary: Implement disputes, reversals and reconciliation exception queue
issues.description: Fraud, underdelivery, chargebacks and failed payouts need assigned operational resolution.
acceptance: Record reason, evidence, owner and monetary impact
Require independent approval for sensitive adjustments
Daily exception report resolves every bank/ledger mismatch before payout close

issues.summary: Build agreed fleet dashboard against real data
issues.description: Preserve simple navigation and vehicle-level operational clarity.
acceptance: Top nav Dashboard/Contracts/Billing; no sidebar or separate Drivers page
KPIs Total Vehicles, Total Drivers, Total Earnings and Total KM
Required vehicle table and All Drivers widget show scoped fresh data with empty/loading/error states

issues.summary: Deliver contract loadboard and My Contracts
issues.description: Fleet owner must understand eligibility, availability and next action.
acceptance: Search/filter available contracts and display campaign name, requirements and estimated earnings
Book eligible vehicle, show hold expiry and generate code through authorized command
My Contracts filters and actions reflect backend lifecycle

issues.summary: Deliver billing and account-security workspace
issues.description: Strong visual security design must correspond to functioning controls.
acceptance: Billing shows approved payout schedule/model, methods and history
Method changes require verification and expose pending/completed states
Security page shows actual MFA, recovery and session capabilities; no decorative security claims
issues.evidence: WrapGo billing and payouts dashboard.png; WrapGo profile and security workspace.png

issues.summary: Complete EN/RU/AM localization and accessibility
issues.description: Brand direction includes dark UI, #39FF14 and Lufga; verify font language coverage.
acceptance: Audit all pilot copy and date/currency formats in three languages
Use #39FF14 as sole accent and agreed 18–20px fleet card radius
Test keyboard navigation, contrast, long translations and Armenian font fallback

issues.summary: Version complete database schema and migration workflow
issues.description: Inspected repository includes two SQL scripts, not a complete reproducible domain schema.
acceptance: Capture schema, RLS, indexes, triggers and storage policies as versioned migrations
Apply to clean staging and reconcile with deployed schema
Add migration review and backup/roll-forward plan; never run cleanup deletes blindly
issues.evidence: Repository tree; location SQL includes destructive deduplication DELETE statements

issues.summary: Create automated CI and critical regression coverage
issues.description: No test/lint/build scripts appear in inspected package.json; tree has no workflow files.
acceptance: Required CI covers static checks and reproducible build
Add meaningful tests for binding, access control, telemetry, ledger and failure branches
Record supported app build profiles and environment separation
issues.evidence: package.json and main repository tree; externally configured CI unknown

issues.summary: Prove backups, restoration and sensitive-data retention
issues.description: Database-only recovery does not prove restoration of photo/document evidence.
acceptance: Restore database plus required object evidence into isolated environment
Measure agreed RPO/RTO and document restore owner
Approve retention/deletion rules for raw location, identity evidence and finance records

issues.summary: Deploy operational approval, support and audit tools
issues.description: Marketplace operations need a real control surface beyond mobile and fleet screens.
acceptance: Reviewer can verify evidence, reject with reason and inspect assignments
Finance role can investigate payment exceptions without editing ledger history
Append-only audit records actor, action, entity, reason and correlation ID

issues.summary: Instrument reliability and production response
issues.description: Measure stalled workflows and financial exceptions as well as application crashes.
acceptance: Alerts cover tracking lag, stuck review, expired holds, callback failures and reconciliation differences
Dashboards include release and correlation IDs without sensitive data
Named on-call and incident runbooks are exercised

issues.summary: Validate Armenia operating and data obligations
issues.description: This review makes no legal-compliance determination; final contracts and obligations need qualified verification.
acceptance: Obtain Armenia counsel and bank confirmation of marketplace fund flow, advertiser/driver/fleet contracts and consent
Approve location privacy, retention, photo evidence, invoices and payout beneficiary obligations
Record required changes with accountable owner before real-money pilot

issues.summary: Run controlled end-to-end pilot and release gate
issues.description: A working screen is insufficient evidence for safely operating paid campaigns.
acceptance: Exercise funded campaign through booking, driver approval, install, valid telemetry, period close and payout
Run rejection, expiry, permission loss, duplicate callback, deletion, refund and restore cases
No unresolved P0; reconcile all pilot money; product, engineering and finance sign off; keep prototype private unless user approves public release

additional_web_findings.summary: Replace raw card and CVV database writes with tokenized payout methods
additional_web_findings.desc: Confirmed in Fleet/Billing.js handleAddCard: insertPayload contains card_number and cvv, inserted via service.js insertBankData into bankdata. Transfer payload also copies full card number. Live data presence has not been inspected; no production exploit claimed.
ac: Use provider-hosted/tokenized method enrollment; no CVV or raw PAN in application writes, transfers, logs or analytics
Authorized security owner assesses and remediates any existing sensitive fields without exporting card records
Retain provider token and display-safe metadata only; negative test rejects forbidden fields

additional_web_findings.summary: Replace client withdrawal balance mutation with atomic ledger command
additional_web_findings.desc: Confirmed in Fleet/Billing.js handleWithdraw: reads cached balance, updates fleets.balance, inserts transfer; failed insert triggers client rollback. Concurrent requests or failure between writes can leave inconsistent balances. Coordinates with ledger and payout issues, while isolating current web defect.
ac: Client cannot write balance or transfer financial state directly
Server transaction validates available balance/beneficiary and idempotency key
Concurrent withdrawals and timeout/retry tests cannot overspend, double pay or restore stale balance

additional_web_findings.summary: Enforce server-verified step-up and new-address ownership for email changes
additional_web_findings.desc: Confirmed in supabase/functions/update-email/index.ts: function validates session then uses admin.updateUserById with email_confirm true. Separate old-email OTP is only a client precondition; direct function call does not verify it. This permits verification bypass for an authenticated caller; no cross-account takeover is claimed.
ac: Server verifies fresh operation-bound step-up and new-address ownership or uses secure built-in change flow
Direct invocation without required proof is rejected even with a valid ordinary session
Old/new email, replay, expired challenge and rollback cases preserve identity relationships without exposing provider internals

additional_web_findings.summary: Authorize and rate-limit invitation delivery; escape template input
additional_web_findings.desc: Confirmed send-invite-code edge function accepts caller-supplied recipient, code and fleetName, without an in-function identity/fleet ownership check; HTML interpolates inputs. Gateway JWT configuration is unknown. Related WEB-25 covers email delivery but not these authorization/abuse controls.
ac: Authenticate fleet owner and derive recipient/code from an authorized invitation record
Apply per-account/invitation quotas and do not send arbitrary caller-supplied codes
Escape template text; test unrelated fleet, invalid JWT, replay and delivery failure
